vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Prepare accurate draft programme logs and identify scheduling conflicts.
requirements.zh: 编制准确节目日志草稿，并识别排程冲突。

requirements.en: Check campaign assets, cancellations and pending deliveries against approved bookings.
requirements.zh: 依据获批预订核对广告活动素材、取消事项及待交付内容。

requirements.en: Communicate timing changes and maintain controlled handovers.
requirements.zh: 沟通时间调整，并按既定控制流程完成交接。

requirements.en: Work with programme-log approval and revision procedures.
requirements.zh: 按节目日志审批及修订程序工作。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently operate the live playout console.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立操作实时播出控制台。
